title: Duels of the Planeswalkers: card flavor text

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: A land whose early hunters devised a weapon that returns to its source.

entities.name: Tolarian Æthermancers
entities.description: Mages of Tolaria who developed a spell that skipped the returning weapon entirely.

entities.name: Saprazzans
entities.description: A people for whom delicate sprites carry messages.

entities.name: Mercadia City
entities.description: A city whose filthy markets the sprites refuse to land in.

entities.name: Emperor Aboshan
entities.description: An emperor who welcomes the sea reclaiming all life.

entities.name: Alexi
entities.description: A zephyr mage who supplies the breeze to reveal warriors as smoke.

entities.name: Mahamoti Djinn
entities.description: A djinn of royal blood among the spirits of the air, a master of trickery and misdirection.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker and mind mage who advocates dominating the mind rather than fighting the body.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: The ascendant evincar, whose soul was snared by an angel's curse and who twisted heroism into its purest shadow.

entities.name: Nevinyrral
entities.description: A necromancer, author of the Necromancer's Handbook.

entities.name: Necromancer's Handbook
entities.description: A writing by Nevinyrral praising the dead as soldiers.

entities.name: Eidren
entities.description: The perfect of Lys Alana, who considers those without beauty Lorwyn's greatest tumor.

entities.name: Lys Alana
entities.description: An elvish domain whose perfect is Eidren.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: The world of the beauty-obsessed elves and their winnowers.

entities.name: Winnowers
entities.description: Elves who live to eliminate eyeblights.

entities.name: Eyeblights
entities.description: Creatures the elves deem too ugly to exist.

entities.name: Vradeen
entities.description: A vampire nocturnus who delights in the circle of stress and pain.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: A villain who praises mental attacks.

entities.name: Aphetto
entities.description: A place where no one answers a knock at the door after sundown.

entities.name: Codex of the Constellari
entities.description: A prophetic writing about a second child born under the moon.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A dragon-revering planeswalker for whom the dragon is the purest expression of life's savage splendor.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A task mage with a fiery wit.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: A land whose mountains are mastered by the Shivan dragon.

entities.name: Molimo
entities.description: A maro-sorcerer who speaks for nature over civilization.

entities.name: Wirewood
entities.description: A forest that cannot hide great size, where elves survive by speed and skill.

entities.name: Gaea
entities.description: A nature deity who sings with the voice of nature rampant.

entities.name: Cylian elves
entities.description: Elves who seek visionaries' guidance to learn the will of the gargantuan ancients.

entities.name: Mul Daya elves
entities.description: Elves called fanatics by other tribes, with an iron-strong bond to a greater force.

entities.name: Raven's Run
entities.description: A haunted place of legendary murderous horrors.

entities.name: Dawn's Light Palace
entities.description: An elvish palace with high tiers.

entities.name: Wren's Run
entities.description: A deeply shaded forest place.

entities.name: Æther
entities.description: The source from which mages summon creatures.

events.summary: Crovax's soul was snared by an angel's curse, and he twisted heroism into shadow, becoming the ascendant evincar.
events.quote: His soul snared by an angel's curse, Crovax twisted heroism into its purest shadow.

relations.note: Eidren is the perfect of Lys Alana.

relations.quote: Winnowers live to eliminate eyeblights, creatures the elves deem too ugly to exist.

relations.note: Sarkhan reveres dragons; the Shivan dragon masters Shiv's mountains.
relations.quote: For Sarkhan Vol, the dragon is the purest expression of life's savage splendor.
